# Aster Documentation

> Aster is a self-hosted, open-source AI agent platform (AGPL-3.0). It connects language models with external tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), provides persistent vector memory, multi-agent orchestration, and a visual chain designer — all running exclusively on your own infrastructure.

Aster turns isolated language models into integrated, action-capable assistants. A master planner analyzes complex requests, breaks them into subtasks, and delegates them to specialized agents. Each agent has its own tools, decision logic, and persistent memory. All data stays on-premise.

Core capabilities: multi-agent orchestration with A2A delegation (up to 5 levels deep), MCP server integration (Docker-isolated), long-term vector memory (pgvector), visual chain/workflow designer, scheduled automation (cron), Agent Skills (open agentskills.io standard — compatible with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), multi-tenancy with RBAC and Row-Level Security.

Tech stack: Node.js/TypeScript backend (Fastify), React/TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL + pgvector, rootless Docker for MCP server isolation.
